GiveWell funded participatory women's groups for maternal and newborn health (PLA-MNH) led there. GiveWell published one public model of its work; the most recent, from January 2023, puts it at **4.7× GiveDirectly (GW: 12× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.
